name: Piranha
appearance: A deep-bodied fish with tight scales and triangular cutting teeth. The portrait uses a silver flank and copper-red throat. The book describes the school’s behavior.

habitats: Fresh water and salt water (aquatic summoning tables, p. 378)

Combat.name: Approaching the school
Combat.effectNote: When a creature swims or wades near the school, there is a 75% chance that at least one piranha attacks.

Combat.name: Feeding frenzy
Combat.effectNote: If the piranhas attack and draw blood, the whole school frenzies. Each piranha attacks twice per melee round.

Combat.name: School attack limit
Combat.effectNote: Up to 20 piranhas can attack one man-sized target simultaneously.

notes: Fresh Water I and Salt Water I each summon 3d4 piranhas on p. 378. Roll the Fish table’s 5–50 for a natural school.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, Fish pp. 117–118.

name: Giant Piranha
appearance: A deep-bodied piranha with a heavy jaw and forked tail. The portrait shows the rising posture of a sky-eater. The book describes its leap rather than a specific color or length.

Combat.name: Approaching the school
Combat.effectNote: When a creature swims or wades near the school, there is a 75% chance that at least one piranha attacks.

Combat.name: Feeding frenzy
Combat.effectNote: If the piranhas attack and draw blood, the whole school frenzies. Each piranha attacks twice per melee round.

Combat.name: School attack limit
Combat.effectNote: Up to 10 giant piranhas can attack one man-sized target simultaneously.

Combat.name: Sky-eater leap
Combat.effectNote: Once per round, a giant piranha can charge at full speed and leap up to 10 feet above the water. It often strikes at low-flying waterfowl and sometimes at people.

notes: The Giant Piranha shares the ordinary school’s attack behavior. Use its own number appearing and simultaneous attack limit.
Giant Piranha appears in Fresh Water II on p. 378.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, Fish pp. 117–118.

name: Quipper
appearance: A cold-water piranha. The portrait uses silver-blue scales and a compact piranha silhouette.
notes: The Quipper paragraph identifies it as a cold-water freshwater piranha. The standard Piranha paragraph supplies the family’s frenzy procedure. The Quipper entry does not explicitly apply that procedure.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, Fish pp. 117–118.
